name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: New Companion tab: a Jellyfin admin can now generate a one-time connect code for a Plex-owning friend to paste into their own Federation Companion app, letting that friend's Companion instance import this server's federated catalog and keep it in sync automatically (added ServerKind.Companion - a consumer-only peer that's only ever the target of the existing Peer/* API, never dialed out to). The same tab also closes a gap in the other direction: pasting a Companion-generated connect code now actually adds the friend's Plex server here (POST ExternalServers was already built but had no admin-UI screen calling it). 306 tests, all green.
